Sherlock.note: Use a username derived from the number, not the number itself.

Holehe.description: Check if email/phone is registered on services
Holehe.note: Requires email format; phone support is limited.

Twint.note: Deprecated/fragile; searches tweets containing the number.

GHunt.note: Requires an email, not a phone number.

Mr.Holmes.note: Mr.Holmes is a fully interactive menu-driven tool (no CLI flags) -- run it, then choose 'Phone Number OSINT' from the menu and paste the number in when prompted. Cannot be auto-scripted safely.

SpiderFoot.description: Full OSINT automation with phone number modules
SpiderFoot.note: Auto-run by PhoneOsint if cloned to ~/.phoneosint-tools/SpiderFoot (see install.sh); no persistent server or API key needed for this single-module scan.

theHarvester.note: Not phone-specific; use with a domain linked to the target.

report.disclaimer: This tool only gathers publicly accessible metadata. Names, exact addresses, and private accounts require paid/authorized data or breach sources. City/region accuracy depends on carrier and public data availability.

carrier_gateways.note: These are unofficial guesses since the real carrier isn't confirmed without a paid API. SMS/email gateways are only reliably known for US carriers; other countries generally do not expose public carrier email gateways.

email_lookup.note: No reliable free API maps a phone number to an email. Use paid/authorized breach services (DeHashed, Snusbase, Intelligence X) or Google dorks that pair the number with 'email', 'mailto', or '@'.

business_dorks.note: These are search/directory links only; a match confirms a publicly listed business number, not personal ownership.

aadhaar.reason: No free/public API maps a phone number to Aadhaar data. This is restricted by the Aadhaar Act, 2016 and UIDAI regulations.
aadhaar.authorized_channel: Only UIDAI-licensed AUA/KUA entities (banks, telecom operators, certain govt agencies) can perform Aadhaar e-KYC, and only with the number holder's explicit consent (OTP-based). Law enforcement must go through official UIDAI/legal channels (e.g. court order or MHA-approved request), not a public API.
aadhaar.warning: Any third-party tool/site claiming to reveal Aadhaar details from a phone number is either a scam or operating illegally. Do not use such services.

paypal.technique: Manually entering a phone number or email as a 'Send Money' recipient in the PayPal app/website sometimes shows a partially-masked name (e.g. 'J*** D**') if that contact has a PayPal account linked to it.
paypal.why_not_automated: Automating this requires a real authenticated PayPal session and repeated lookups, which violates PayPal's Terms of Service and risks account suspension/legal action. PhoneOsint does not perform any login or automated requests against PayPal.
paypal.manual_use_only: If you choose to check this yourself, do it manually, sparingly, and only with proper authorization.

extra_apis.note: No numlookupapi.com / Abstract API / Veriphone.io key provided; skipping. All three offer a small free-tier monthly quota if you want live carrier data.

gravatar.note: No email address available to check against Gravatar. Gravatar cannot be queried by phone number directly.

shodan.note: No Shodan API key provided; skipping remote lookup

numverify.note: No Numverify API key provided; skipping remote lookup

local_breach_search.note: Results are only as good as the file(s) you provided via --breach-file; PhoneOsint performs no verification of this data's accuracy, legality, or provenance. You must have proper authorization to possess and query any dataset used here.

dark_web.note: Dark web search links only. Pass --tor to route live queries through a local Tor proxy.

hlr.note: No Twilio Account SID/Auth Token provided; skipping HLR/line-type lookup (this is a paid Twilio feature, no free alternative exists).

upi.note: No Cashfree Client ID/Secret provided; skipping UPI name lookup (requires your own KYC-approved Cashfree Payouts merchant account -- no free public API exists for this).

ignorant.note: Checks Instagram, Snapchat, and Amazon account existence via the free 'ignorant' library (no login required).
